headers.events:
projection-identity-v1; explicit solvePrepared chains only; no timing or reuse certificate
seq	epoch	operation	site	phase
headers.samples: id	epoch	operation	site	resolved_pair	local_count	selected_old	removed	changed	deleted	alias_left

identity_grammar: Signed Int64 lists in square brackets; resolved_pair=Nothing or Just (signed,signed). IDs are original graph-domain keys.
legal_counterresults: Zero pairs, low overlap, high key-write footprint and truncated prefix are retained without rerun. At most first32 eligible pairs; not population coverage.
meaning: Pairs reference two same-epoch operation-consecutive samples. Only left writes describe the transition from left input selection to right input selection. removed/changed overlap; compute union, never sum.
qualification: diagnostic capture only, never production equivalence or optimization qualification
scope: Only explicit Constraint.solvePrepared chain; flushGeneration and public uninstrumented Solver paths excluded. No global current owner.
